# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and teacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c6 P4](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0004), [v3 c4 P11](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0011)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nonie  <sub>[v2 c6 P4](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0004), [v3 c4 P5](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora has fair skin and light, ethereal-looking hair. She is tall in stature, exceeding most of her peers in height.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c6 P4](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0004), [v3 c4 P8](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0008)_

## Personality

Honora is thoughtful, humorous, and creative, often engaging in playful banter. Beneath her lighthearted nature, she possesses a deep appreciation for poetry and the beauty of the natural world. She is a loyal friend who enjoys imaginative discussions and values meaningful connections.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c6 P11](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0011), [v2 c6 P19](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0019), [v3 c4 P15](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0015), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)_

## History

Honora Hollis attended school at Brierley alongside Nell Harcourt, where she was recognized as a clever student. She later pursued teaching at Delford before entering Regent's Academy. Honora subsequently decided to attend Wexcombe College to further her education, where she roomed with Nell Harcourt at Tabby's Place. Along with her friends, she participated actively in college life and the Brierley Village Improvement Society.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c6 P4](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0004), [v3 c4 P8](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0008), [v3 c4 P11](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0011)_
